description: This file defines the SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator class, which helps set up and configure an ADO.NET-based stream provider within an Orleans silo. It includes methods for configuring ADO.NET options, cache size, and partitioning of stream queues.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up ADO.NET stream provider options on an Orleans silo, including methods for configuring ADO.NET options, cache size, and partitioning.

methods.name: SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configurator with a name and configuration delegate, setting up default options and validation.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Allows external configuration of ADO.NET stream options via a provided delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures the cache size for the stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions (queues) for the stream provider.
